title: FIX
synopsis: In a delicate world made entirely of folded paper, an anxious middle-school singer discovers a real pushpin with the extraordinary power to hold anything in place. The discovery promises control in a world where everything feels uncertain.
awards: Honorable Mention — Higgsfield Global Film Festival 2026

audienceReactions.quote: Mind-blowing idea! Incredible video! This is beyond amazing. If this doesn't take 1st place, something is definitely wrong!
audienceReactions.author: @ssk4126

audienceReactions.quote: The paper-textured characters really solve the staleness and awkwardness you get in typical AI videos — feels fresh. I love how full and rich this short film feels.
audienceReactions.author: @물동이-z1f
